A must stop place.
Apr 2025 • Solo
I had been in Vietnam for 8 days. I was loving the food but was craving something more than fish and veggies. Pho was not going to satisfy me. I stopped in here and asked for a burger to go. I had no expectations and oh was I surprised. I thought the best burger I had was in Japan at a place called Dragon Burger. Now I don’t know. The bun was amazing. The burger cooked perfectly juicy and tender. This place knows better than Americans on how to make a good burger. Don’t miss it!

Pleasant Burger at Burger Joint
Aug 2022
We had a pleasant time at Burger Joint and would return there in the future. The place is smart, the waitress was very friendly and attentive and there was a large selection of sauces to suit all taste. The burger was pleasant enough although the size of the overly generous jalapeno peppers in the Jalapeno burger was a bit off putting and overwhelmed the experience a bit. The french fries were good and served piping hot, which is a definite plus to my mind. My husband had the bacon and onion burger. Both of us thought that the burgers were very good but somehow lacked the wow factor. I think next time we would choose different burgers to compare the combinations of taste and will review again if the rating should change. But definitely a tasty place for a lunch.
